fusions.name: Cold Rivet
fusions.desc: Fires a cold-forged rivet that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Grounding Spike
fusions.desc: Drives a grounding spike into the earth, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances.

fusions.name: Bolted Plates
fusions.desc: Bolts heavy plates over you, raising your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Riveted Layers
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, another plate is riveted on, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per plate (56% at full). Unfed, a plate falls away every 10 seconds.
